svg.title: DuckDB never materialised the rows
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “DuckDB never materialised the rows” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a star schema with a narrow ten-million-row fact table at the centre and four small dimension tables around it; a slowly-changing dimension drawn as three stacked versions of one merchant row carrying valid-from, valid-to and is-current, with an as-of query landing on the middle row; a bar chart of one group-by over ten million rows where DuckDB takes 0.117 seconds and 96 megabytes against pandas at 1.510 seconds and 878 megabytes, with polars in between; and two directory trees where daily partitions are marked good and two hundred and fifty thousand per-user directories are crossed out in red.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
